title: The master vampire falls
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: the frozen great hall of Frostfall Fortress at night, frost on the stone, broken banners, moonlight through a high window. Durzo: a lean half-elf rogue with swept-back silver-white hair and pointed ears, in fitted red-and-black leather armour, holding a pair of daggers; he has just landed the final blow on a tall, gaunt master vampire in a dark high-collared cloak, which is collapsing and dissolving into shadow and ash. The vampire is half-transparent, as if only Durzo could ever see it. Durzo stands over it, exhausted and bloodied but triumphant. Cold blue light with an ember glow on the blades.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Durzo. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.
